Job

Introduction

The document of Hub, this (is) one story concerning a righteous/sensible person who caused_to_suffered_disaster of terrible destruction—all his children died(pl), all his wealth disappeared(pl), and terrible sickness indeed also came to him. And there are seven portions of stories of this reading_document. And by_means of that stories, the writer informed what Hub and his friends felt concerning of that destructions. And the important portion of the story, (is) the means of God (MS Manama) leading his people. And then, God reveals himself to Hub.

Near the beginning of this reading_document, Satan tells God that leading his people is not good that he rewards those who are righteous. So the result is the people were doing right just for the rewards. And their doing right is not from their heart anymore. And this is indeed what he tells about Hub. That's why God allows Satan to test Hub's faithfulness if he will remain righteous when he suffers.

And by_means of old believing/faith, the friends of Hub explained that he was_suffering because he had_sinned. But for Hub, it wasn't [wishfully] correct that he suffered with that punishment because he (was) a righteous/sensible person. He didn't understand why God permitted that terrifying sickness came_to him when he (was) a righteous/sensible person. Therefore he challenged God that they will_go to the court. And despite that, the faith/believing by Hub wasn't lost, but he wanted that he be_recognized as righteous/sensible by God, and (that) he could_be_accept honor as a righteous/sensible person.

God didn't answer the questions by Hub. But God confirmed the faith/believing by Hub, by_means of his power and knowledge. And Hub recognized that God is more wise, along_with his humility, and he requested forgiveness for what_ he _said from his anger.

And the ending of this document, informed that Hub's good living was_made_to_return to him, and he (was) more prosperous than before. And God scolded at the friends of Hub, because they didn't know why Hub suffered. Only Hub understood that God (is) stronger than the old faith/believing.
